To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have derived an exact expression for interface observables in the 3D Ising model from the Nambus-Goto string theory.

the Nambu–Goto effective string theory describes well the interface free energy of the 3d-Ising model, that the Nambun–Goto string tension is the inverse of the correlation length and that the Nambuno–Goto string length is the correlation length.

the partition function of interfaces can be obtained exactly in terms of an infinite sum of Feynman diagrams in the physical gauge of the Nambu- Goto model; this expression compares very well with the Monte Carlo data for values of area sufficiently large with respect to the inverse string tension, in agreement with previous analyses of the same data.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the derivation of the exact partition function of interfaces from a first principle approach, and the analysis of the results in comparison to numerical simulations.
the interface free energy of the Ising model in 3d and the Nambu Goto string theory.
a new approach to the problem of the partition function of interfaces, which is based on an effective string description of the physics.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Nambu--Goto effective string theory is an excellent approximation of the 3d--Ising model for values of the areas large in terms of inverse string tension.
the Nambu--Goto effective string theory describes the physics of interfaces in the 3-d Ising model.
the NG string theory is a good candidate for a description of the interfaces in the 3D Ising model.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Nambu- Goto effective string theory provides an accurate description of interfaces in the 3D Ising model.

we have found an exact result for the NG model which compares well with the data of the 3d-Ising model for large area interfaces, and that this comparison provides an independent check for the validity of the Nambu Goto effective string theory as description of the physics at large scales.
the NG model is a good description of interfaces in the Ising universality class, in particular for the large values of the area.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Nambu Goto model is a very good approximation for the physics of interfaces in 3d, at least in the large area limit.

, at least in the Ising case, the NG model can be considered as an effective string model for the physics of interfaces, in the sense that it is able to capture some of the most relevant features of the interface free energy.
the Nambu Goto effective string theory provides a good description of the physics near criticality for a wide range of models.
